subject: Error in connecting mssqlserver database using shiny webserver

messages.author: 42d6ba49240c4dcf
messages.subject: Error in connecting mssqlserver database using shiny webserver
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to connect to mssql  database  using shiny app webserver(https://www.shinyapps.io/).  I am able to connect to sqlserver by installing the shinyweb server in the local system  and using the connectionString as Driver=Sql Server;Server=104.211.96.159,1433;Database=makarandsystems;Uid="";Pwd=";". 

But the same connection when used for deployment on the server we get the odbc error and we are unable to connect to the mssqlserver which is in Azure...

Kindly let me know if I am missing some thing obvious...?

Sincerely,
P.Srinivas Kumar

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error in connecting mssqlserver database using shiny webserver
